label: ERA5-Land
selected_scope: Global ERA5-Land hourly reanalysis, 1950-present, as referenced by GEE hourly, daily aggregate, monthly aggregate, monthly-by-hour and static entries. Multi-product family, not one archive.

download_size.scope: No total selected for the ERA5-Land family; CDS requires user-selected variables, times and area.
download_size.basis: Producer download interface exposes GRIB and experimental NetCDF4 and selectable dates/variables, but no fixed all-family archive byte total. No request submitted.

alternative_sizes.display: 227,185,344,000 bytes (~227 GB decimal), raw float32 array payload
alternative_sizes.scope: Illustrative one-variable global 0.1° grid for one complete 365-day hourly year (3600 longitude cells × 1801 latitude cells × 8760 hours). Not a compressed download estimate and not whole ERA5-Land archive size.
alternative_sizes.basis: 3600 × 1801 × 8760 × 4 bytes per float32 value; grid spacing/global coverage/hourly cadence from producer product documentation. Assumes every grid/time cell is stored as a four-byte value; excludes masks, metadata, compression, packing and any missing-point optimizations.

rationale: Chunked Zarr fits the full grid/time dimensions where a cloud-native publication is needed; use/reference the producer ARCO Zarr for its point/limited-area scope. Preserve source units, coordinates and variable metadata.
existing_cloud_native: CDS publishes a maintained ARCO Zarr subset for point/limited-area long time series; the full gridded product remains distributed separately. Prefer referencing ARCO where its subset scope matches.
caveats: GEE contains several temporal aggregations and a static image; these are not interchangeable with the hourly archive.
Full archive size varies with requested variables, period, area and encoding.
